control: Reproduce the frozen V18 basis_breadth discovery ledger exactly before opening candidate economics; if discovery passes, reproduce its frozen validation ledger before transfer judgment.

candidate.admission: Every exact V18 trade enters at the same next-minute matched-MCL open; no signal is delayed, suppressed, replaced, inverted, or added.
candidate.direction_and_route: Exact V18 direction, acceptance/failure branch, basis-breadth route, and multiscale ownership attribution.
candidate.adverse_first_exit: Only the frozen Stage-76 actionable adverse-first cohort exits at its exact next-minute MCL open. Structural decision is checked before the existing failed-auction profit-memory owner on that minute.
candidate.all_other_positions: Exact V18 failed-auction 0.5-percent activation/25-percent MFE retention, raw-turn invalidation, contract roll, and period boundary.
candidate.after_abort: Remain flat until the next authentic V18 admission; no re-entry.
candidate.marking: Complete dated-MCL one-minute high/low MFE and MAE, multiplier 100, conservative structural-before-intrabar ordering.

selection_law: Open validation only if action/control/abort identity and every discovery gate pass. Validation and full prefix must each pass the exact transfer gates; there is no neighbor or fallback. Missing July-2023 through August-2024 still forbids a crown even on complete success.
prohibitions: no first-passage magnitude, timing, persistence, bar-count, book subset, favorable/adverse subset, entry-delay, or confirmation neighbor
no V18 admission, direction, branch, route, parity, maturation, cadence, roll, cost, profit-memory, or ordinary-exit change
no ATR, slope, velocity, basis, phase, session, stop, target, timeout, reverse, add-on, re-entry, sizing, news, or quota rescue
no validation outcome unless every discovery gate passes
